title: Sx exit handlers are registered, then called on entry with Phase 0
description: The dispatcher accepts exit handlers, then calls them during entry with Phase 0 because the comparison ignores Phase.
not_established: No real exit client or physical failure is established.
remediation: Separate 34-byte-difference PE candidates return EFI_UNSUPPORTED for exit requests and free the unused record. C1 local, C2 physical validation. Entry and power-button controls pass.
